build_opinion_abstracts_dataset: build a tensorflow dataset builder for the OpinionAbstracts dataset with rotten_tomatoes or idebate config
create_opinion_abstracts_config: create an OpinionAbstractsConfig builder config specifying filename, name_key, id_key, opinions_key, and summary_key
run_dataset_download: run the dataset builder to download and extract the OpinionAbstracts zip from the official URL
generate_dataset_examples: generate dataset examples by parsing JSON and yielding opinion abstracts with name, id, summary, and opinions
review_builder_info: review the Builder _info method to inspect dataset features schema and supervised keys configuration
